note: Curated, non-exhaustive highlights from Microsoft partner AI agent libraries, selected to show real breadth from each partner's catalog rather than a redundant copy of AIBAST's own lineup. Descriptions, what_it_does, problem_it_solves, and who_it_helps are paraphrased in our own words for what the partner publicly states the agent does; they are not endorsements, resale offers, or verified benchmarks. Where the partner's own page states a quantified result (partner_reported_outcome), it is quoted verbatim and is explicitly partner-reported, not independently verified by AIBAST. See each agent's source_url for the partner's own listing.
guidance: Use this catalog to learn what other Microsoft ecosystem partners are building with Copilot Studio and Dynamics 365 — patterns and use cases you can borrow ideas from, independent of AIBAST's own catalog. Every entry here follows the same research and verification standard documented at partner-standards.html.

partners.name: CongruentX
partners.description: Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform partner publishing a public library of 40+ Copilot-based sales, insurance, distribution, and professional-services agents.

agents.name: Buyer Intent Enrichment (web + CRM)
agents.description: Enriches anonymous web and CRM signals into scored buyer intent so marketing and sales can prioritize outreach to the accounts showing real interest.
what_it_does: Detects buying intent from web and CRM activity
Prioritizes outreach toward the accounts showing the strongest intent
Personalizes content and timing to match where each account is in its journey
problem_it_solves: Anonymous intent signals go uncaptured
Lead quality and volume are inconsistent
Generic content underperforms with in-market buyers
agents.partner_reported_outcome: 20–50% higher campaign ROI vs broad programs

agents.name: Hyper-Targeted Market Segmentation
agents.description: Segments the addressable market at a granular level so campaigns can be targeted to the highest-propensity segments instead of broad, unfocused programs.
what_it_does: Detects intent and prioritizes outreach by market segment
Personalizes content and timing to each segment
problem_it_solves: Intent signals go uncaptured at the segment level
Marketing spend is spread across low-fit segments
Generic content underperforms across a broad audience
agents.partner_reported_outcome: +5–15% marketing ROI, reduced spend on low-impact segments

agents.name: Dynamic Journey Orchestration (CI Journeys Copilot)
agents.description: Orchestrates multi-channel nurture journeys and next-best-action sequencing across email, web, and ads based on real-time engagement signals.
what_it_does: Surfaces ICP fit and segment insights
Aggregates research to equip early discovery conversations
Builds next-best-action sequences across email, web, and ads
Auto-enrolls segments into targeted journeys
problem_it_solves: ICP and message-market fit are fragmented across channels
Discovery quality is low and leads are poorly qualified
Manual journey-building slows down campaign cycles

agents.name: Event/Webinar Persona Journeys
agents.description: Builds automated, persona-specific follow-up journeys for event and webinar attendees based on how engaged each attendee was.
what_it_does: Builds automated follow-up journeys segmented by persona and engagement level
problem_it_solves: Event and webinar follow-up is created manually and inconsistently
agents.partner_reported_outcome: +10–20% higher MQL→SQL conversion on event leads

agents.name: First-Impact: Claims Setup & Portal
agents.description: Guides a policyholder through their first claim and first portal use so the initial experience builds trust instead of confusion.
what_it_does: Guides first claim and first portal use step by step
problem_it_solves: First-time claim and portal experiences lack visibility and guidance
Engagement and volume are inconsistent during early claim interactions

agents.name: ICP Targeting by Line (P&C/Life)
agents.description: Targets prospects by ideal-customer-profile fit for a specific insurance line (P&C or Life), aggregating research to equip early discovery conversations.
what_it_does: Surfaces ICP fit and segment insights by insurance line
Aggregates research to equip early discovery conversations
problem_it_solves: ICP and message-market fit are fragmented across lines of business
Discovery quality is low and leads are poorly qualified
Manual research slows down the sales cycle

agents.name: Risk & Loss Ratio Storytelling
agents.description: Turns loss-ratio and risk data into a next-best-action narrative so underwriters and account teams can explain risk trends and engage the right stakeholders.
what_it_does: Surfaces ICP fit and segment insights from loss-ratio data
Aggregates research to equip risk conversations
Builds next-best-action sequences across channels
problem_it_solves: Loss-ratio and risk data is fragmented across systems
Risk conversations lack supporting research
Manual analysis slows down underwriting and account reviews

agents.name: Loyalty Tier Triggers → Offers
agents.description: Watches loyalty-tier signals and automatically triggers the next relevant offer or advocacy ask at the right moment in the customer relationship.
what_it_does: Surfaces cross-sell and upsell moments from loyalty-tier signals
Activates advocacy and reference requests at the right moment
problem_it_solves: No systematic trigger exists for cross-sell moments
Advocates and references are hard to find
Attach rates and loyalty stay flat without a structured trigger

agents.name: Dormant Account Reactivation (Leads)
agents.description: Finds inactive accounts and builds a re-engagement play with an updated offer and story to win them back.
what_it_does: Finds and re-engages inactive accounts
Builds a targeted, updated offer and story for reactivation
problem_it_solves: Dormant accounts go untouched without a systematic reactivation play
Offers and messaging go stale for lapsed accounts

agents.name: Service Contracts & Attach Rate Signals
agents.description: Prompts the right warranty or service contract at the point of sale, using signal detection to raise attach rates without a manual upsell script.
what_it_does: Prompts warranties and service contracts at the point of sale
problem_it_solves: Visibility into attach-rate benchmarks is limited
Retention stays low without a point-of-sale service prompt

agents.name: Target Accounts by Buying Committee
agents.description: Maps the buying committee inside a target account and prioritizes outreach to the specific roles involved in the decision.
what_it_does: Detects buying-committee membership and prioritizes outreach
Personalizes content and timing per stakeholder role
problem_it_solves: Buying-committee signals go uncaptured
Lead quality and volume are inconsistent
Generic content underperforms with mixed-role buying committees
agents.partner_reported_outcome: Higher win rate, larger average deal size (5–15%)

agents.name: Thought Leadership Orchestration
agents.description: Orchestrates thought-leadership content and next-best-action sequencing across channels to build pipeline influence over a longer sales cycle.
what_it_does: Surfaces ICP fit and segment insights for content targeting
Aggregates research to equip early discovery
Builds next-best-action sequences across email, web, and ads
Auto-enrolls segments into targeted content journeys
problem_it_solves: ICP and message-market fit are fragmented across content channels
Discovery quality is low without supporting research
Manual content sequencing slows down pipeline influence
agents.partner_reported_outcome: Strong influence on pipeline; higher engagement, 5–10% more opps sourced
